exposure: Standardized algorithm for managing cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
Treatment modalities (suction curettage, methotrexate combined with suction curettage, hysterotomy, gravid hysterectomy, expectant management)
outcome: Complication rates (bladder injury, ureteral injury, estimated blood loss >=3000 mL, >4 units of packed red blood cells, admission to the intensive care unit, poor outcomes)
cohort: The participants were 53 women diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated between January 2014 and September 2024.
finding: Expectant management for cesarean scar pregnancy was associated with a significantly higher complication risk compared to termination strategies guided by a standardized algorithm, which improved CSP outcomes.
gest_age: Cases included pregnancies of various gestational ages, with specific analysis for those under 14 weeks and beyond 14 weeks, as gestational age was a factor in treatment decisions.
